title: knock-knock input
description: Domain names (or URLs) to check. Expiration info comes from official registration records (RDAP), or straight from Ethereum for ENS (.eth) names.

domains.title: Domain names
domains.description: Domain names, URLs or ENS names to check, e.g. example.com, https://www.example.co.uk/page, gemini://example.org or vitalik.eth. Subdomains are checked via their registrable domain name.

checkCertificates.title: Check TLS certificates
checkCertificates.description: Also connect to each host and check when its TLS certificate expires, and whether it's trusted (port 443, the port from the given URL, or 1965 for gemini:// URLs).

warnDays.title: Needs attention within (days)
warnDays.description: Results are marked with needs_attention = true when the domain name or certificate expires within this many days (or a check fails). Handy for filtering results in integrations and webhooks.

ethRpcUrl.title: Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoint
ethRpcUrl.description: Used for looking up ENS (.eth) names. Defaults to https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com. Note that this is stored as part of the run's input, so avoid URLs containing private API keys.
